messages:
carmen (AM): FYI Sorrel Health wants to start a 4-week POC next Monday. They want to test a 8B-int4 cheap variant + a 65B-fp16 for high-accuracy. Procurement also asked about a flat POC rate option and confirmation that model weights can be pinned to dedicated hardware in EU.

 samir (sales-eng): Procurement asked for a simple paragraph: either token-discount (easier) or a flat fee for the POC. Suggested: hosted tokens @ 30% off for trial or flat $12k/month for the estimated 120M tokens. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

 hannah (infra): 30% off hosted OK. Dedicated pinning for weights (isolated volumes + customer KMS) is doable in eu-west-1, full single-tenant hardware only for Private deployments. Need to confirm capacity for 65B replicas in region.

 yusuf (ml eng): Drop the HF id and I'll run a quick compat + perf. Also tell me expected seq lengths.

 carmen (AM): HF id: hf.co/sorrel/clinical-synth-1. Avg 420 tokens, spike tests to 3072. They want eval harness and latency SLOs.

 ci-bot (legal-bot): Noted: MSA review will be needed if flat pricing or infra commit requested.

 yusuf (ml eng): Ran compat scan: `./compat-check --model hf://sorrel/clinical-synth-1 --quant int4,fp16,65b --runtime rwd-v3`
Findings: tokenizer ok. INT4 export uses a custom fused rotary-attention op our int4 kernels don't support -> runtime fallback on that op, estimated +20-35% latency on affected sequences. 65B-fp16 requires 3x A100-80GB slices per replica; model uses a custom fused softmax that matches our GPU kernels but host-side sharding requires mem-optimizer flag.

 hannah (infra): Capacity note: eu-west-1 has limited A100-80GB inventory. Options: (A) host 65B in multi-tenant hosted pool in eu-west-1 (higher P99), (B) run 65B across cross-region (eu + na) with strict region pinning for token residency (harder), (C) use 8B-int4 dedicated primary + hosted 65B fallback for heavy queries.

 diana (solutions): Customer requirement: P99 < 800ms for 420 tokens and P99 < 2s for 3072 in their integration tests. Can we produce bench numbers and an eval harness by EOD tomorrow? They'll run clinical regressions.

 yusuf (ml eng): Quick local numbers (single replica, batch=1):
- 8B-int4 (dedicated fallback kernels): 420 -> 88ms avg, 3072 -> 380ms avg
- 65B-fp16 (hosted multi-tenant): 420 -> 420ms avg, 3072 -> 1.6s avg
I'll run a 24h perf + p99 run overnight and upload CSV.

 samir (sales-eng): For procurement blurb: "POC options: (1) token pricing with a 30% discount for first billing cycle (recommended), or (2) flat fee $12k/mo for estimated 120M tokens. Dedicated infra waived for first 72h. Region pin to eu-west-1 available. SOW to specify fallback routing." OK to send?

 hannah (infra): Fine from infra. Add note: sustained >50% usage for >2 weeks may trigger capacity review and require a commit. Also confirm logs and keys stay in EU region if we pin to eu-west-1.

 diana (solutions): Security Q draft: "Weights are encrypted at rest (AES-256) and stored on isolated volumes for Dedicated pools. KMS keys can be customer-isolated; HSM option for Private. Audit logs retained per enterprise SLA. We do not expose host SSH or hypervisor access to customer tenants." I'll post full draft to #sales-docs. :lock:

 carmen (AM): Routing plan idea: primary -> sorrel/8b-int4@dedicated-eu; fallback -> sorrel/65b-fp16@hosted-eu; timeout_ms 1200; keep logs for audit. Need a config snippet for the SOW.

 hannah (infra): Sketch routing config:
```
routing {
  primary: model:sorrel/8b-int4@dedicated-eu
  fallback: model:sorrel/65b-fp16@hosted-eu
  p99_timeout_ms: 1200
  region_pin: eu-west-1
  audit_logs: enabled
}
```
Will reserve a tentative 3-node 8B pool (g5g.12x or equivalent) and request A100 quota refresh for 65B.

 samir (sales-eng): Legal asked for a short liability note for the flat fee option. legal-bot, can you flag what we need?

 legal-bot: If flat fee + infra commit requested, escalate to Legal for SOW language: include SLA, capacity commit term, and termination/cost-reconciliation clauses. Tag: @legal-team.

 carmen (AM): Action items: (1) yusuf: 24h perf + CSV + eval summary (2) hannah: reserve 8B pool and request A100 quota, post exact replica types (3) diana: security Q + SOW snippets incl. routing and region pin (4) samir: procurement blurb + flat-fee legal checklist. Need these by EOD tomorrow so procurement can approve kickoff.

 yusuf (ml eng): Starting 24h run now. Will include cost-per-1k-token numbers both with and without int4 fallback. Uploading artifacts to hf://artifacts/sorrel/poc/perf-1878901234.csv when done.

 hannah (infra): Reserved 3x g5g.12x equivalents for 8B pool (eu-west-1), est throughput ~5.5k tokens/s. A100 quota request submitted for hosted 65B; will update when approved.

 diana (solutions): Drafted security doc and short SOW snippets; dropping into #sales-docs and tagging @carmen. Noted the runtime patch note for the customer re: int4 fallback.

 samir (sales-eng): Drafted procurement paragraph and included both pricing options and the 72h free infra clause. Will circulate to Carmen for sign-off.

 carmen (AM): Thanks everyone. If legal or capacity blocks show up, ping me immediately. Aim to have MSA/SOW signed before the POC start next Monday. :rocket:
